scripts.name: firefly
scripts.title: Firefly
scripts.author: Futuro Cube Suite
scripts.about: A firefly flits around the cube. Tilt so your cursor (the up-facing square, blue) is under it and tap to catch it. Catch ten as fast as you can; it gets jumpier as you go.
